name: Brave Browser
priceNote: Shields is built into the free browser. No data-broker removal at any price.

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data
features.rival: No — Brave has no broker/people-search scan

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo
features.note: Privacy Monitor Assistant Lite — lighter automatic removal, fewer broker removals — is free with a qualifying Norton subscription per support.norton.com (Getting started with Privacy Monitor, Privacy Monitor Assistant, and Privacy Monitor Assistant Lite).

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site
features.rival: Shields panel lists blocked trackers — not broker-removal proof

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')
features.rival: Yes — blocks 3rd-party ads/trackers and cross-site cookies

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites
features.note: The only other company whose fingerprint wording matches Norton's disguise/randomise level.
features.rival: "Fingerprint randomization" — 'makes you look different to every site, each time you restart the browser'

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers
features.rival: Not stated on official site on the Shields pages checked

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk
features.rival: Yes — Shields panel shows detailed list of blocked ads/trackers, scripts, fingerprinting attempts, cookies

tiers.highlight: One free tier: Shields tracking + fingerprint protection in the browser
tiers.name: Brave Browser — only tier
tiers.note: There is no higher tier: broker scan/removal is not sold at any price.

refs.label: Brave Shields
refs.proves: Free $0.00, randomizing fingerprint wording, cookie blocking, Shields list

gaps.detail: Norton states no search engine. Checked: Norton Neo (Universal Search is a browser search feature, not a standalone search engine), Norton Private Browser (search-agnostic — choose Bing or Google), Norton 360, Genie.
gaps.name: Brave Search
gaps.rivalHowSold: Free (default search in Brave; also at search.brave.com)

gaps.detail: Norton states no search engine (and so no premium search subscription). Checked: Norton Neo (Universal Search is a browser search feature, not a standalone search engine), Norton Private Browser (search-agnostic — choose Bing or Google), Norton 360.
gaps.name: Brave Search Premium
gaps.rivalQuote: A premium subscription supports the Brave Search mission, and brings ad-free results.

gaps.detail: Norton states no video-calling product. Checked: Norton Ultimate Help Desk (helps set up third-party video-conferencing tools — support, not a calling product), Norton 360, Norton Family.
gaps.name: Brave Talk
gaps.rivalHowSold: Free for small groups; Premium is a separate subscription (7-day free trial)
gaps.rivalQuote: Brave Talk brings unlimited, private video calls for small groups, right to your browser.

gaps.detail: Norton states no crypto/Web3 wallet product. Checked: Norton Money (financial-wellness app: Plaid account linking, spending tracker, Equifax credit score — no crypto wallet), LifeLock, Password Manager (stores credentials, not crypto).
gaps.name: Brave Wallet
gaps.rivalQuote: Brave Wallet is the only secure Web3 wallet built directly into a private browser. Use of Brave Wallet is totally free.

gaps.detail: Norton states no rewards programme. Checked: Norton 360, LifeLock, Norton Money, Private Browser, Neo.
gaps.name: Brave Rewards (BAT)
gaps.rivalQuote: Brave Rewards gives you the option to view first-party, privacy-protecting ads while you browse (these ads are from the Brave Private Ads network). If you choose to view them, you earn BAT via the Brave Rewards program.

gaps.detail: Norton states no news feed product. Checked: Norton Neo (Split View shows news alongside browsing — a layout feature, not a news feed), Private Browser, Norton 360.
gaps.name: Brave News
gaps.rivalQuote: They'll simply be able to remove features like Leo, News, Rewards, VPN, Wallet, Web3 domains, and more.
